Alyssa Chen: Heads-up — NovaHealth QBR prep. Need a compact cost slide: token econ, 90d conservative spend forecast, recent budget alerts, and suggested mitigations. Can we collate numbers here?

Jamal Reed: I'll own the slide. Emily, can you paste the last 30d breakdown and any anomalies?

Emily Park: On it. Quick note: embedding micro-batch retries on 2026-03-08 caused a spike. Will include delta.

ops-bot: ALERT: novahealth-prod hit 82% of monthly reserved spend at 03:22 UTC (auto-alert to #customer-success). Invoice ref: nh-332.

Marco Rivera: Confirmed via customer: two large import jobs ran 3/8, they reduced batch size after.

Emily Park: Paste: ```Last 30d:
- total_tokens: 14,720,392
- embeddings_tokens: 6,900,112
- generation_tokens: 7,820,280
- billed_usd_30d: $7,860
- anomaly_3-08: approx +420k tokens (embeddings) => est $235```

Priya Patel: Enablement flagged an upcoming live demo (expected +40% query volume for 72h). Recommend we pre-config quota and a temporary burst cap for the demo window.

Alyssa Chen: For the slide, suggest we list mitigations + alert thresholds (what do you recommend?).

Emily Park: Recommend: 70% / 85% / 95% alerts (email + slack), auto-fallback route to quantized-embed-v2 for non-critical jobs, enable KV prefix caching where applicable, and temp burst cap (2x for 72h) for the demo.

Jamal Reed: I'll model forecasts. Emily/Marco 1: confirm conservative 90d forecast including demo spike?

Marco Rivera: Conservative 90d: ```baseline (no spike): $22,500
with demo spike: $29,100
Assumptions: +40% for 3 days in month 1, then 5% MoM growth thereafter.```

Emily Park: Confirmed. Uploaded CSV with 30/60/90 day scenarios to the QBR folder.

Alyssa Chen: Customer asks: clearer per-embed line item and an option to cap daily embedding spend. Marco, can you file a product request?

Marco Rivera: Will file in product board and paste ticket link here after sync.

Priya Patel: Offer: 30-min enablement session to walk NovaHealth engineers through batching best practices and switching to quantized models. Tentative: Mon before QBR.

Jamal Reed: Action list:
1) Jamal - build cost slide (owner)
2) Emily - attach CSV + alert screenshots
3) Marco - product ticket for cap feature
4) Priya - schedule enablement session
5) Alyssa - finalize QBR deck and send to AM by EOD Fri

Alyssa Chen: Perfect. Tag me when the slide draft is ready. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: NOTE: Budget alert thresholds [70,85,95] created for novahealth by @Emily Park.

Marco Rivera: Customer quote for slide: "We love the latency but need clearer per-embed cost to plan demos."

Alyssa Chen: Good. I'll stitch slide together and ping for quick review.
